response.original_title: Steven Wilson: Requiem for a Village
response.overview: Requiem for a Village is the ninth studio album by the English progressive rock musician Steven Wilson, released on 6 November 2026 via Fiction Records.  The concept album is set in an isolated, fictional village somewhere in the British Isles, whose inhabitants maintain their own customs and traditions. It takes inspiration from the 1975 British folk horror film of the same name, as well as British folk music, literature and television programmes from the late 1960s and early 1970s.
response.title: Steven Wilson: Requiem for a Village
